page.overview:
Who is Lead Blueberry Scout?

She is the leader of the Blueberry scouts. She is seen congratulating Francis (who is recovering from a broken leg) for saving their youngest member, Dot, and reveals that they have changed their bandanas and voted Francis their honorary "den mother." She is the only Blueberry Scout other than Dot to have dialogue.
